subject: AtlasMed onboarding: implementation playbook & kickoff
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Dr. Emily Stone <emily.stone@atlasmed.com>, Rajesh Menon <rajesh.menon@atlasmed.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, procurement@atlasmed.com, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 21:02:00 -0400
Subject: AtlasMed onboarding: implementation playbook & kickoff

Team — looping you all in to transition AtlasMed to CS and kick off implementation. Quick summary for context and commitments: 

- ACV: $480k ARR, 24-month term.
- Primary use case: clinical note summarization + embeddings for search across patient records.
- Committed launch: production pilot for two clinics by 2026-07-15; full rollout by 2026-09-30.
- Contract stipulations: SOC2 + restricted logging window (30 days) per procurement; see SOW.

What I’m handing off (attached): SOW (v1.2), integration checklist, and the implementation playbook draft. Key technical notes:
- AtlasMed will use our hosted API for the pilot, but they want ability to transition to Dedicated in Q4 if throughput grows.
- They use Okta for SAML SSO (Emily will provide metadata) and a private VPC for EHR connections.
- Expected peak RPS for pilot: ~8 req/s with 512-token avg responses; plan for batching at the inference layer.

Primary contacts:
- Atlas: Dr. Emily Stone (clinical lead) — emily.stone@atlasmed.com
- Atlas Ops: Rajesh Menon — rajesh.menon@atlasmed.com
- Redwood SRE/SE: Dev Patel (technical lead) — dev_patel@redwood.com
- Redwood CS owner: Monica Patel (cc’d) — monica_patel@redwood.com

Proposed next steps / asks for CS:
1) Monica / Stephanie: confirm CS owner and lead for technical onboarding (single point).
2) Schedule kickoff with Atlas: suggested windows next week: Tue 19th 10–11am ET or Wed 20th 2–3pm ET.
3) Dev: validate integration checklist and call out any blockers for pilot (EHR connectivity, sample payloads).
4) Procurement (procurement@atlasmed.com): pending signature of SOW — procurement/contact assigned?

Please review attachments and reply with the CS owner + preferred kickoff slot. I’ll remain on the thread for the first two weeks of implementation for any contract/expectation clarifications.

Attachments: AtlasMed_SOW_v1.2.pdf (SOW v1.2), integration-checklist.csv, redwood-implementation-playbook.docx

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0126

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Dr. Emily Stone <emily.stone@atlasmed.com>, Rajesh Menon <rajesh.menon@atlasmed.com>, procurement@atlasmed.com, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: AtlasMed onboarding: implementation playbook & kickoff

Thanks Karthik — great context and congrats on closing. Monica here, I’ll take ownership of the CS engagement and run the pilot. High-level approach from CS: 

- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): align on SSO metadata, data access plan, point-of-contact for EHR team, and sign-off on SOW.
- Week 1–2 (kickoff -> tech integration): SE-led integration pairing with Atlas and test endpoint validation.
- Week 3–6 (pilot): run pilot, gather quality metrics, iterate on prompt templates & quantization options.
- Success criteria for pilot: 95% uptime, latency p95 < 450ms for 512-token responses, clinical lead sign-off on summary quality for a 250-sample eval.

I can host the kickoff. Suggested times (aligning w/ Karthik): Tue 19th 10am ET or Wed 20th 2pm ET — both work for me today. Dev, can you confirm availability for a 60-minute technical slot?

Pre-kickoff asks for Atlas (Emily / Rajesh):
- Provide Okta SAML metadata JSON + test user
- Provide sample EHR export (de-identified) — small batch (~100 records) for preprocessing tests
- Identify network firewall owner (for potential whitelisting)

I’ll pull the implementation playbook into a shared Drive folder and assign action owners there. Laura, I’ll loop you for any billing/ops items. Procurement — let us know if you need any changes to the SOW terms.
